answer_json.answer: Fear of being left out of a move

lesson_text: Fear of being left out of a move. FOMO stands for the fear of missing out. In trading it is the fear of missing out on potential market moves. It feels like something exciting is happening while you sit on the sidelines. Its urgency drives rushed, impulsive decisions. It is not the fear of a loss: FOMO is about a gain you are not in. FOMO wants you in now, on somebody else's move.
